messages:
deploy-bot: kicking off release/2025.06.20 llm-autofill toggle. flag=llm_autofill_v4 set to canary, pinned binary=v4.0.0-rc3. change window 23:00-01:00 UTC. tagging @ellie @noah for ramp ops.

ellie: acknowledged. ramp plan proposal: canary 2% -> 10% -> 30% -> 100%. holdpoint after each step. soak durations: 12m, 18m, 10m. health gates = 5xx_rate < 0.3% && p95_latency delta < +80ms && generation_quality check pass (sampled BLEU-like eval).

noah: uploaded preflight checklist and release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2025-06-20-autofill. includes rollout matrix and required KV keys to monitor. Added `rollback_playbook.md`.

leo: add an automated safety mute: if p95 > baseline +120ms for 5m OR 5xx_rate > 0.8% for 3m then auto-disable flag and pin to v3.9.8. deploy-bot pls add a synthetic alert.

tara: prefer small extra buffer at 10% (30m) since feature touches many short queries. Also request model cache warmup step before full shift: prefetch common prompts to reduce cold latency.

deploy-bot: ran dry-run checks: build ok, infra quota ok, canary pool reserved (hosts: 12). initiating canary toggle now.
```
[2025-06-20T23:02:12Z] build success
[2025-06-20T23:04:01Z] deploy to canary pool started (hosts=12)
[2025-06-20T23:06:00Z] flag llm_autofill_v4 set to 2% (cohort: canary)
```

ellie: canary started. monitors: @ops-oncall @noah @tara. starting 12m soak.

noah: quick sanity: sample responses look okay. small uptick in GPU memory sampling on 2 hosts (~+70MB) but no OOMs.

[8 minutes later]
ops-oncall: noticing a transient p95 spike +95ms on host-07 for ~2m, 5xx still zero. holding promotion. investigating thread.

ellie: suggest running `model-pool-rebalance` on host-07, could be uneven sharding.

ops-oncall: rebalance issued, host-07 memory usage stabilized. p95 trending down.

deploy-bot: canary heartbeat: healthy=11/12, p95_latency=322ms (baseline 240ms), 5xx_rate=0.05%. manual_hold=true.

noah: given p95 delta ~+82ms at peak, still within gate but close. I'll extend canary soak to +10m before 10% shift. tagging @leo.

leo: agree extend. also enable the synthetic quality-check job to sample 100 prompts every 5m. failure threshold = >2% incorrect completions -> pause.

[soak extended]
ellie: after extended soak, metrics steady. promoting to 10%.

deploy-bot: flag llm_autofill_v4 set to 10%. logs:
```
[2025-06-20T23:34:00Z] flag set to 10%
[2025-06-20T23:34:30Z] quality-check job started (n=100)
```

tara: quality-check shows 1.2% failures (within threshold). p95 delta ~+50ms. proceed to 30% after 30m.

[15 minutes later]
ops-oncall: small cluster of 5xx from edge router (rate 0.4%) correlated with a downstream cache timeout. not service-wide. reduced after increasing cache timeout 200ms -> 800ms.

noah: good catch. holding the 30% shift for 10m to confirm.

leo: if 5xx does not drop under 0.2% after 10m we have an auto-mute. command to revert: `deploy-bot rollback-flag llm_autofill_v4 && deploy-bot pin-service v3.9.8` (ops playbook).

ellie: noted. adding that revert command to the incident channel template.

[40 minutes later]
noah: metrics are stable. 5xx back to 0.05%, p95 delta +48ms, quality-check 0.8% failures. proceeding to 30% then 100% per plan with attached soak times.

deploy-bot: rolling to 30%: `flag llm_autofill_v4=30%`

ops-oncall: watching for tail latency and any memory OOMs during scale. set alert on OOMs and router errors.

[final note]
tara: final release note entry: include timeframe, ramp steps, the temporary rebalance step we ran, and the exact rollback command. also add a short blurb about increased p95 during early canary and how we fixed it.

end of thread: manual follow-ups assigned to @noah (update relnotes) and @ellie (postmortem doc if any revert happens).
